body.label: Effect
body.html: On a success, deal 1 weapon damage. If the target is Prone or Exposed, deal +1 weapon damage.

surges.html: Deal +1 weapon damage; you suffer -1 Defense until the start of your next turn.
On a success, move the target 1 unit. You may move with it.

rider.title: FINISHER
rider.html: After rolling, you may spend 2 Combo. If you do, this Action ignores 1 Defense and gains +1 weapon damage on a success.
